name: 18724-sharedprefix-llada2mini-1gpu
model: inclusionAI/LLaDA2.0-mini. NOT SUBSTITUTABLE: the engine's diffusion path recognises exactly this architecture family and raises on anything else. Ungated, bf16, ~32.5 GB over 7 safetensors shards.
parallelism: tp1 on one card -- 32.5 GB of weights and at most a few hundred MB of KV. EP=1, PP=1 (the engine pins pipeline parallelism to 1 on this path), single node, no disaggregation.
architecture: LLaDA2MoeModelLM, a DIFFUSION language model: 20 decoder layers, hidden 2048, 16 query over 4 key/value heads at head_dim 128, sparse MoE of 256 routed experts top-8 plus 1 shared, ~16 B total against ~1.4 B active, bf16, no quantization and no draft model.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, bounded at 200 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, seed 42, first 10% of the run discarded as warmup.
workload: A REAL DATASET, NOT SYNTHETIC TEXT: five-shot GSM8K, shipped with the item as configs/data/gsm8k-5shot-200.jsonl. 200 rows, one turn each, no chat template -- the raw text goes to /v1/completions. Prompts measure 865.8 tokens mean (sd 23.9, min 829, max 939) with this checkpoint's tokenizer. Generation is temperature 0.0, max_tokens 512 and three stop strings; output length is NOT pinned and typically lands near ~120 tokens. Exactly one pass over the file, so no question is asked twice.
purpose: A grade-school math tutor solving five-shot word problems for 32 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# One H100 serving a diffusion language model, answering five-shot grade-school arithmetic.

# NOT INTERCHANGEABLE: this engine's diffusion path recognises exactly this architecture family
# and raises on anything else.
model-path: inclusionAI/LLaDA2.0-mini

# The checkpoint carries its own modelling code. Required to load it at all.
trust-remote-code: true

tp-size: 1

# How many requests are denoised in one forward. It defaults to ONE on this path -- omit this
# line and the engine serves strictly one request at a time however many clients are waiting.
max-running-requests: 4

mem-fraction-static: 0.9
attention-backend: flashinfer

# The decoding rule: repeatedly unmask the positions of a 32-token block the model is already
# confident about; the block closes when every position is filled or after thirty-two passes.
dllm-algorithm: LowConfidence

cuda-graph-bs: [1, 2, 3, 4]
